messages.subject: Re: Run analysis before navigating to a tab
parts:
Hi Joe, 

The subsequent analysis in other tabs is dependent on completing the forward curve analysis in the market tab.  I am using isolate to stop reactive when I move on to analytics.  

  • I would like Forward Curve to compute without activating the Forward Curve tabPanel.  I want this to constantly update while when the app is processing streaming data. 
  • I was thinking about having the analytics process all default values before allowing the user to navigate to a tab for the simple reason that when input is NULL (while processing)  the renderDataTable does not return an empty table.  Thus, the user would see a full default table once the analytics have processed.  I have optimized the tabs to a point that they renderdatatable quick enough to be instant but I still need to remove error while inputs are changing. 

in a nutshell I would say I am asking to hold the user back until a table is rendered an populated.  If the table rendered empty by default with row names I would care less about requirement.
